images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Interior of a clock tower mechanism room, side view looking toward the back of a huge translucent opal-glass clock face that fills the center, strongly backlit by the morning sun so it glows warm amber and white; the Roman numerals are seen mirrored from behind, and the dark silhouettes of the hour and minute hands show through the glass. In front, a train of polished brass gears with spokes and crisp teeth in rim light: a large wheel at left, a swinging pendulum with a round bob, an escapement wheel with anchor at top left. One swappable gear axle in the middle is highlighted by a rotating dashed teal ring with the label '교체 축 C · 30톱니'. Dust motes in the light shafts. Bottom-left: through an iron floor grate we see the cobblestone town square far below with a fountain, trees and tiny people with red warning pins. Right side: dark bronze UI panel with a needle gauge reading '+3:12', four cream paper appointment cards with red and green status tags, and a tray of four spare gears labeled 24/30/36/40. Top HUD: '시계탑 수리공', clocks '07:41' and '07:44'. Painterly semi-realistic illustration, brass and amber palette, deep sepia shadows, film grain, vignette. Number constraints: the two HUD clocks are labelled "실제 시각 07:41" and "시계탑 07:44" so the tower is 3 minutes fast, matching the gauge "+3:12"; the hand silhouettes on the glass face show 7:44 (mirrored from behind).

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Dusk view looking down from the clock tower window onto a European-style cobblestone square; the bronze rim of the clock face frames the top edge. Blue-violet evening sky tones, rows of townhouses with warm lit windows, gas street lamps casting amber pools on the stones. A diagonal lane runs through the square: a small black coal cart has already passed and exits up the lane, trailed by a dotted teal path arrow. Near the corner, a red dashed circle and a ghost outline of the cart mark the collision that would have happened, labeled '맞췄다면 · 17:40 충돌 지점', while a line of schoolchildren in colorful coats walks safely toward it. By a small fountain an apprentice sits alone on a bench. Bottom: a causal timeline of cream paper cards joined by arrows, times 07:30, 12:02, 16:55, 17:40 highlighted in teal, and one dark red card '만약 맞췄다면'. Right: bronze results panel with a big teal '1' for '막은 사고' and a gold button '다음 날'. HUD clocks '17:40' and '17:42'. Painterly illustrated style, bittersweet quiet mood, grain, soft vignette.
